note: Which aircraft each shipped non-campaign mission offers, by role (plan F5B, Mark's ruling 2026-10-15). THE one place: the catalog builder (so launchSortie accepts exactly these) and Form 5 (so the form shows exactly these) both read it. The P-38 and the other advanced airplanes are deliberately absent: an entry-rank non-campaign mission may list only non-advanced airplanes (the F5A lifeline invariant), and a chapter that wants one carries its own list (F10). Only aircraft with a spec in content/aircraft/ are listed; a Japanese mission lists only the Zero because the sortie rule treats every non-authored Japanese airplane as an enemy airplane outside Dev (src/sim/sortie.ts). The mission's authored airplane is always first. A chapter authored later (F10) carries its own list on its descriptor.
